Stigg is a pricing and packaging platform providing feature management, entitlements, and usage-based billing for SaaS and API products. The Stigg API exposes GraphQL and REST endpoints for customer provisioning, subscription management, entitlement checking, and usage reporting. Authentication requires a Full access key passed via the X-API-KEY header.
